edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — volley every wave contact and bank the overwhelm stacks on his health bar.
edits.after: Pre-6 Vladimir still can't trade back — you chunk him faster than Transfusion heals. Keep banking stacks.

edits.before: Golden Eclipse online — the execute threshold turns your chip war into a countdown he can see.
edits.after: Hemoplague plus a charged Tides of Blood is his one real all-in — and Sanguine Pool dodges your root.

edits.before: Luden's spike: snare-volley chunks half bars and the execute cleans the remainder. Force contacts.
edits.after: Your first item out-paces his sustain — Q chunks faster than Transfusion heals and W blunts his E.

edits.before: Late Mel is a counter-artillery battery: reflect their poke, snare their dive, and execute the chipped.
edits.after: Bait Sanguine Pool, snare the recovery frames, and Golden Eclipse executes before his healing catches up.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Rebuttal has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Sanguine Pool: 28s at rank 1, 16s max — the untargetable dodge; bait it before you spend your kill window. - Transfusion cycles every 9-4.6s; poke in the gap after he heals. - W Rebuttal (38s early) is for his post-pool all-in. - R (120s) only when Overwhelm is banked.

edits.after: Snare his Transfusion step-up, volley, and back off before his Q returns — your chip outruns his heal in short trades.
